Test Case Title: Time Clock - A. View inspections on a work order line
Preconditions: Logged in as Time Clock. No Work Orders access. A work order line has at least one inspection.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
As Admin, create/configure a custom role matching the 'Time Clock' profile; assign it to a test user; log out and log back in as that user (fresh login so permissions load); then:
1. Log in.
2. Open a work order that has an inspection on a line.
3. Locate the inspection on the line.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Login succeeds.
Step 2: Work Orders are not accessible to this role.
Step 3: Inspections cannot be reached - no Work Orders access.
Actual Result (Observed): Time Clock role DOES grant workOrdersView -> Work Orders ARE accessible in the Tech UI (landed on /workorders, WO list rendered). Existing inspections on a line are therefore reachable/visible (read-only, since role lacks Work Order Lines rights). This CONTRADICTS the expected "no Work Orders access".
Status Rationale: Time Clock system role grants workOrdersView, so Work Orders / Digital Inspections are reachable read-only — contradicts its clock-in/out-only intent (VIU-33).
Spec / Requirement Reference: SV-7506 · Digital Inspections — Time Clock role · VIU-33: The 'Time Clock' system role is clock-in/out-only and should NOT grant Work Orders access; Work Orders and Digital Inspections should be unreachable…

Test Case Title: Time Clock - G. Inspection status labels display correctly
Preconditions: Logged in as Time Clock. No Work Orders access. A line has inspections in different states.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
As Admin, create/configure a custom role matching the 'Time Clock' profile; assign it to a test user; log out and log back in as that user (fresh login so permissions load); then:
1. Open a work order line with inspections in different states.
2. Observe the status labels.
Expected Result: Step 2: Not applicable - no Work Orders access, statuses cannot be seen.
Actual Result (Observed): Work Orders ARE accessible for Time Clock (has workOrdersView), so inspection status labels CAN be seen - contradicts expected "no Work Orders access, statuses cannot be seen".
Status Rationale: Same root cause as DI-111: the Time Clock role grants workOrdersView, so WO content (including inspection status labels) is visible — contradicts "no Work Orders access" (VIU-33).

Test Case Title: Invoicing Delete requires Manage AP/AR (AP/AR gate)
Preconditions: Admin account with access to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) and Administration > Staff. A test staff user exists to receive the custom role. Sample records exist in the environment as described in test_data.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. As admin, follow the admin flow to create the custom role. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Enable See Financial Data; keep View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
3. Enable Invoicing & Payments 'Delete / Reverse' (the delete-tier control in this section is labelled 'Delete / Reverse', not plain 'Delete').
4. Confirm/enable View and Manage AP/AR Data.
Expected Result: Invoicing Delete cannot be applied without View and Manage AP/AR Data; the AP/AR gate enforces enabling View and Manage AP/AR Data (in addition to the financial gate).
Actual Result (Observed): Admin role editor with See Financial Data ON and AP/AR OFF: enabling Invoicing 'Delete / Reverse' checked View+Create&Edit+Delete but did NOT trigger any 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' gate modal and left AP/AR unchecked. Expected an AP/AR gate enforcing AP/AR enablement.
Status Rationale: Missing AP/AR dependency gate on Invoicing Delete/Reverse: the See-Financial-Data gate fires but the parallel View-and-Manage-AP/AR-Data gate is not wired, so a role can hold Delete/Reverse without AP/AR access (VIU-32).
